_about: Yard 9 signs and Kasp's memo posters, Writer's placeholder pass (VS-31, 2026-10-09; final text at VS-37, Ross approves). jk_j1_screen and jk_j1_memo are the two examine spots the Level Designer placed in J1. The other jk_* ids are a poster library for spots the Level Designer can add in J2 to J4 and the arena (each id needs a spot node and a placement; none is wired yet): jk_j2_memo, jk_j3_memo, jk_j4_memo, jk_arena_memo, plus jk_j2_sign, jk_j3_sign and jk_j4_sign for yard signs. Kasp's voice: an office manager who means every word. He signs memos 'K.' or 'Sgt. Kasp'. Dungeon tone stays grim-funny (Ross has not loosened the dungeons).

jk_j1_screen.speaker: narrator
jk_j1_screen.text: A weighbridge screen, looping a memo about noise tickets. Under the loop, a counter: DAYS SINCE A COMPLAINT: 0.

jk_j1_memo.speaker: sign
jk_j1_memo.text: MEMO. Noise is a choice. Choose less. - K.

jk_j1_memo.speaker: narrator
jk_j1_memo.text: Someone has underlined 'less' twice. Someone else has underlined 'choose'. The clipboard-shaped sign looks tired.

jk_j2_memo.speaker: sign
jk_j2_memo.text: MEMO. Canyon turrets are fitted for your safety. Please do not take this personally. They do not. - K.

jk_j3_memo.speaker: sign
jk_j3_memo.text: MEMO. The crane is for authorised lifting only. Authorised lifters: me. Authorisation: pending. - K.

jk_j4_memo.speaker: sign
jk_j4_memo.text: MEMO. Wreck Row is a heritage site. Do not climb on the heritage. Do not climb in the heritage. - K.

jk_arena_memo.speaker: sign
jk_arena_memo.text: MEMO. This is a staging area. Staging is a verb. Please stop standing in it. - Sgt. Kasp

jk_j2_sign.speaker: sign
jk_j2_sign.text: YARD 9: SHIFT BELL IS BANNED. SHIFT LIGHT IS PERMITTED. IT IS VERY BRIGHT. DO NOT LOOK AT IT.

jk_j3_sign.speaker: sign
jk_j3_sign.text: COOLANT PIT. 9 METRES. NO LIFEGUARD. NO COMPLAINTS.
